description: JVM Maven Central Registry Submission: discover, prepare, submit, and evidence Maven Central publication for io.github.edithatogo:mchs.
blocker: Minimal JVM module, Maven publishing metadata, credential-safe Central Portal repository wiring, and in-memory signing wiring are checked in and local build passed; namespace verification, signing key material, publish credentials, publish validation, and authenticated release remain pending.

preparation_evidence.discovery: Maven Central search for g:io.github.edithatogo AND a:mchs returned numFound=0.
preparation_evidence.fixedLocalBlocker: The JVM binding module is under bindings/jvm and uses a Java 11 toolchain for Maven Central readiness.
preparation_evidence.remainingExternalBlocker: Central Portal namespace verification, signing key provisioning, Gradle publish credentials, authenticated Central Portal release, and public Maven Central verification remain pending.
preparation_evidence.gradlePublishingMetadata: bindings/jvm/build.gradle.kts includes java-library, maven-publish, signing, group io.github.edithatogo, artifact mchs, required POM metadata, a single Central Portal deployment repository configured only when a deploy URL is explicitly provided, and in-memory PGP signing via Gradle properties or environment variables.
preparation_evidence.jvmBuildEvidence: gradle -p /tmp/mchs-registry-push/bindings/jvm build --console=plain passed in commit fc162f2.
preparation_evidence.centralPortalRepositoryWiring: bindings/jvm/build.gradle.kts includes a centralPortal Maven repository only when -PcentralPortalDeployUrl or MAVEN_CENTRAL_DEPLOY_URL is present; publish tasks fail closed without URL, credentials, and signing key.
preparation_evidence.failClosedPublishCredentials: Gradle Central Portal repository URL and credentials are read from Gradle properties or environment variables and fail closed when absent.
preparation_evidence.workflowEvidence: .github/workflows/publish-maven-central.yml provides a manual workflow_dispatch path with dry_run default true and fail-closed validation for CENTRAL_PORTAL_USERNAME, CENTRAL_PORTAL_PASSWORD, MAVEN_SIGNING_KEY, and MAVEN_SIGNING_PASSWORD.
preparation_evidence.workflowDryRunValidation: gradle -p bindings/jvm publishAllPublicationsToCentralPortalRepository --dry-run --console=plain succeeded without credentials after aligning Central Portal and signing properties.
preparation_evidence.workflowCredentialModel: GitHub Actions workflow uses CENTRAL_PORTAL_USERNAME, CENTRAL_PORTAL_PASSWORD, MAVEN_SIGNING_KEY, and MAVEN_SIGNING_PASSWORD; real publish validates those secrets only when dry_run is false.
preparation_evidence.workflowDryRunCredentialPolicy: GitHub Actions dry_run path no longer forwards empty secret-backed Gradle properties; real publish adds deploy URL, Central Portal credentials, and signing properties only when dry_run=false.
